function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, source-grounded investigation of the overall question: How do the sources describe Conti as a ransomware-as-a-service operation; what do Conti-related leaks reveal about its organizational and operational structure; and how do law-enforcement records connect specific aliases and defendants to Conti activity? Use only evidence returned by the benchmark tools. Locate and preserve the exact source IDs returned by the tools and tie every factual statement to those IDs. Cover relevant entities, aliases, defendants, organizations, dates, activities, and relationships only where directly supported. Separate verified facts in official records from allegations, analytical assessments, media reporting, and unresolved uncertainty. Look specifically for official indictments, complaints, warrants, sanctions, advisories, court records, and primary leak materials, while also capturing credible analytical descriptions of the RaaS model and internal Conti chats or documents. Identify contradictions or competing accounts, including differences in dates, roles, aliases, or attribution. Do not infer identities or relationships not stated in a source, and do not fill gaps from general knowledge. Return a structured evidence memo with: (1) source inventory and source type; (2) RaaS description; (3) leak-derived organization/operations; (4) law-enforcement alias/defendant links; (5) chronology; (6) verified versus alleged/assessed claims; (7) contradictions and uncertainties. Cite every item solely with the source IDs returned by the benchmark tools."}
function.name: ConductResearch
